submitted.rationale: At 2.1 eV illumination, which is below the gap of the stable Mg-Sb oxides (MgSb2O6 ~2.8 eV by MEGNet, higher experimentally; Mg4Sb2O9 ~4.2 eV), every measured EQE is near zero. Index 26 (Sb 0.757) gave the highest value, 3.3e-4 %. Its XRD is also the only one with film peaks that are not from the Pt substrate (Q 1.91, 2.45, 3.65), so crystalline Sb-rich material forms there. Index 25 read -5.2e-4 %, so the noise is about the same size as all the signals and the ranking has little meaning.
